metaDescription: Kevin reacts to Pete Hegseth's plan to livestream the December 3 firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan and questions the spectacle.
summary: This video is Kevin's reaction to reports that the Pentagon will livestream the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan on December 3. Kevin cites Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's statement to Real America's Voice and Trump's comments. He says he does not object to the firing squad itself but calls livestreaming a bridge too far, comparing it to ISIS broadcasts and the way media amplified Charlie Kirk's death. Kevin wonders whether the announcement is a distraction amid an unpopular war with Iran, and notes legal appeals could delay it.
